purpose: Measure Locus on repositories it was never developed or tuned against, with cases chosen by a fixed rule so that misses cannot be curated away.

excludedRepositories.vercel/swr: Used while developing monorepo workspace resolution (see src/lib/localizer.test.ts), so it is not held out.
excludedRepositories.sindresorhus/got: Used while developing NodeNext specifier resolution (see bin/core.mjs), so it is not held out.

selection.history: First-parent, non-merge commits reachable from the pinned head, newest first.
selection.subject: The commit subject starts with the word 'fix' (case-insensitive), e.g. 'fix:', 'fix(scope):' or 'Fix ...'.
selection.expectedFiles: Files the commit modified (status M) that Locus loads as Graph nodes in the parent snapshot, excluding test files.
selection.task: The commit subject with the leading 'fix' keyword, any '!' and ':' removed, the conventional-commit scope kept as plain words, and a trailing pull-request reference such as '(#123)' removed.

run: Check out the parent commit as a detached worktree and call loadLocalRepo(), buildGraph() and locate() from bin/core.mjs, exactly as the CLI does, with no evidence text.

metrics.fixFileRecall: Expected files present in the returned Slice, divided by all expected files.
metrics.fullRecallCase: A case whose Slice contains every expected file.
metrics.contextReduction: 1 - Slice tokens / repository tokens, using Locus's chars/4 token estimate. A widened case reduces nothing.
metrics.chanceRecall: Expected recall of a uniformly random Slice with the same number of files: Slice files / repository files.

withoutScope.task: The same cases with the conventional-commit scope removed from the task text.
